languageModeBelowSix.text: {{target}} compiles in Swift {{languageMode}} language mode. Swift 6 is required: it makes data-race safety a compile error instead of a warning nobody reads. Set .swiftLanguageMode(.v6) on the target, or remove the setting that lowers it.

languageModeBelowSixInXcode.text: {{target}} compiles in Swift {{languageMode}} language mode<<configurations>>. Swift 6 is required: it makes data-race safety a compile error instead of a warning nobody reads. Set the target's SWIFT_VERSION build setting to 6.0 in every configuration, or remove the setting that lowers it.<<located>>
